name: dictation
description: Speak into the composer: a microphone button that writes what you say at the cursor, through any OpenAI-compatible transcription service.

settings.label: Service address
settings.help: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint, up to and including its version. OpenAI's is https://api.openai.com/v1. For a whisper server on this computer or your network, type its address here, like http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1: Dictation reaches a private address only when you typed it.

settings.label: API key
settings.help: Sent only to the service address above. Leave it unset for a server that needs none.

settings.label: Model
settings.help: The service's own name for it. On OpenAI: whisper-1, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe or gpt-4o-transcribe.

settings.label: Language
settings.help: The language you speak, as a two-letter code like en or de. Empty lets the service tell.

settings.label: Words to expect
settings.help: Names and terms to spell your way, like OpenRemote or Tauri.

settings.label: Longest recording
settings.help: Minutes before a recording stops by itself.
